name: Traversy Media
description: Practical project-based web development tutorials covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js and more. Great for beginners and intermediate developers.

name: Fireship
description: Fast-paced, high-quality videos on modern web development, developer tools, and programming concepts. Famous for '100 seconds of Code' series.

name: Kevin Powell
description: The go-to YouTube channel for learning CSS in depth. Covers flexbox, grid, animations, and modern CSS techniques with clear explanations.

name: Theo - t3.gg
description: Deep dives into modern TypeScript, React, Next.js and the T3 stack. Covers real-world fullstack web development patterns and best practices.

name: The Primeagen
description: Senior engineer at Netflix sharing insights on algorithms, data structures, Vim, Rust, and software engineering fundamentals. Great for intermediate developers.

name: Web Dev Simplified
description: Simplifies complex web development concepts into easy-to-understand videos. Covers JavaScript, React, CSS, Node.js and full-stack projects.

name: Codevolution
description: Structured, beginner-friendly playlists on React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js and more. Perfect for learning frameworks step by step.

name: freeCodeCamp.org
description: Full-length free programming courses on Python, JavaScript, web development, data science, machine learning and more. All courses are completely free.

name: Academind
description: In-depth courses on React, Angular, Vue, Node.js, Docker, and more. Known for thorough, well-structured explanations by Maximilian Schwarzmuller.

name: Hitesh Choudhary
description: Covers JavaScript, Python, backend development and DevOps with practical project-based lessons. Also has Hindi-language tutorials for wider accessibility.
